news.title: Ranchi civic body orders installing rainwater harvesting structures on eligible properties
news.para: The Ranchi Municipal Corporation has taken a bold step by mandating the installation of rainwater harvesting systems for qualifying properties. These systems are essential for recharging groundwater, and property owners are obligated to set them up and maintain them properly. Those who fail to comply could face stringent administrative consequences and potential service disconnections.

news.title: NCLT removes IRP from stalled Noida project for hiding charges against him
news.para: The NCLT has officially dismissed Narender Kumar Sharma from his role as IRP for the Festival City housing project due to non-disclosure of disciplinary actions and the absence of proper authorization. Sudhir Kumar Agarwal has been appointed as his replacement. It's crucial for Sharma to transfer all project documentation to Agarwal, and any costs incurred during Sharma's administration are excluded from the resolution expenses.

news.title: SBI acquires commercial property in Pune’s Kharadi for ₹414 crore
news.para: The State Bank of India has finalised the acquisition of a commercial property in Pune for Rs 414 crore. This deal covers both land leasehold rights and a commercial structure situated in Kharadi, a bustling business district.

news.title: Ban on construction activities in Delhi from December 10 to January 20 to curb air pollution
news.para: Construction activities will be completely banned in Delhi from December 10 to January 20. This measure aims to curb air pollution during the upcoming winter season. Citizens are urged to report any violations of this directive. Sites above 500 square meters will be monitored using AI cameras and a special portal. Notices, warnings, and fines will be issued for non-compliance with the ban.

news.title: Hyderabad's Raidurg land price hits record ₹264 crore per acre in e-auction
news.para: In a record-breaking sale, a prime Hyderabad plot in Raidurg fetched Rs 264 crores per acre. This multi-faceted land auction yielded Rs 1,386 crores for TGIIC, significantly exceeding its reserve price by 50.9 percent. The fierce bidding underscores not just investor confidence but also a robust market environment, highlighting the continuous desirability of high-end plots in this burgeoning corridor.

news.title: Over 880 unauthorised colonies across six districts lack access to sewerage network: Uttar Pradesh CS to NGT
news.para: Uttar Pradesh's chief secretary informed the National Green Tribunal about 888 unauthorized colonies lacking sewerage. These colonies across six districts house approximately four lakh people and generate significant sewage. The state has proposed action plans for sewage treatment and has laid substantial sewer lines. However, the tribunal noted a lack of clear timelines for bridging the sewage gap.

news.title: Karnataka assembly passes bill to regulate apartment ownership, common areas
news.para: On Friday, the Karnataka Assembly approved three impactful Bills aimed at enhancing property rights. One key Bill establishes a comprehensive legal framework for the management of apartment ownership, clarifying individual rights and common area responsibilities. The other Bills enable officials to reclassify private streets as public, addressing the ongoing challenges in property ownership and management across the region.

news.title: Enforcement directorate files status report in sealed cover on investigation into the role of DLF
news.para: The Enforcement Directorate has requested additional time to continue its investigation into the Shikohpur land deal, providing necessary documents to the accused. A translation certificate was also submitted. Robert Vadra attended the hearing via video link, but the court expressed dissatisfaction with an unanswered question in the status report. Further proceedings are scheduled for September 23.

news.title: Ahmedabad’s 2030 growth must be climate-responsive, people-centric: Experts
news.para: At ETRealty Realty and Beyond Ahmedabad, Niraj Shah, Vatsal Chaitanya Joshi, Sherry George and Prashant Das said Ahmedabad’s next phase of growth must balance high-rise development with climate-responsive design, wellness, mobility, accessibility and changing residential needs.

news.title: Future homes must contribute to the city, not just individual lifestyles: Hiren Patel
news.para: Speaking at the Design Keynote The Ahmedabad Home of the Future at ETRealty Realty and Beyond Ahmedabad, Ar. Hiren Patel, founder, Hiren Patel Architects & Design, said architects and developers must create spaces that improve community life, strengthen local identity and remain meaningful over time.

news.title: Gujarat office market needs GCCs, infrastructure, occupier-ready assets: Experts
news.para: At ETRealty Realty and Beyond Ahmedabad, industry leaders said Gujarat’s next commercial real estate growth cycle will depend on GCC expansion, GIFT City, infrastructure, talent access and institutional-grade office assets.

news.title: Architecture must be contextual, not trend-driven: tHE gRID Architects
news.para: Speaking during the session Partners in Practice: Building a Shared Design Language at ETRealty Realty and Beyond Ahmedabad, Snehal Suthar and Bhadri Suthar, co-founders of tHE gRID Architects, said architecture should be shaped by context, climate, observation and long-term practice rather than social media trends or imported design formulas.

news.title: Gujarat housing market shifting from affordability to aspiration: Developers
news.para: At ETRealty Realty and Beyond Ahmedabad, developers said Gujarat’s residential market is seeing demand for larger homes, better design, privacy and lifestyle-led amenities. Redevelopment, infrastructure expansion, industrial investment and emerging corridors such as Dholera are expected to open new growth opportunities beyond Ahmedabad.

news.title: Architecture must reflect heritage, culture and community: Prashant Parmar
news.para: Speaking during the fireside chat Behind the Design at ETRealty Realty and Beyond Ahmedabad, Prashant Parmar, founder & principal architect, Shayona Consultant, said architecture should move beyond buildings to engage with heritage, culture and community identity.

news.title: India may need 15 crore additional urban homes by 2047: CREDAI National President
news.para: Speaking at ETRealty Realty and Beyond Ahmedabad, Shekhar G. Patel, managing director & CEO, Ganesh Housing Corporation and national president, CREDAI, said India’s urbanisation and economic growth could create demand for nearly 15 crore additional homes over the next two decades.

news.title: LiDAR mapping to plug property tax leakages in Trichy
news.para: The Trichy Corporation is set to launch its inaugural GIS mapping initiative, leveraging state-of-the-art drone technology. This extensive survey aims to uncover discrepancies in property tax assessments and mitigate revenue losses. Additionally, it will create a detailed database for improved urban planning. The corporation will accurately track assets such as roads, parks, and streetlights. The mapping will also play a vital role in evaluating green cover and facilitating afforestation efforts.

news.title: Goa government to launch housing scheme during Diwali
news.para: Goa government will launch a chief minister's housing scheme for homeless citizens.  The scheme will provide affordable homes on a lease basis to eligible original Goans.  Strict residency criteria will ensure original residents without homes receive housing.  The Goa Housing Board will also pursue joint ventures for construction projects.  This initiative aims to provide peaceful living spaces until beneficiaries can purchase their own homes.

news.title: Nirman-2 delays stall building approvals, Credai tells Belagavi civic body
news.para: Credai Belagavi has urged the Belagavi City Corporation to expedite the renewal process for engineer licenses. Due to ongoing portal delays, many licensed engineers face challenges in submitting building permission applications. This delay adversely affects builders, engineers, and citizens in need of essential approvals. They specifically requested quicker renewals for alteration and G+4 permissions, ensuring improved civic service delivery and reducing potential disruptions.

news.title: Govt pushes for better coordination among departments to fast-track deemed conveyance for 67,000 housing societies in Maharashtra
news.para: State government directs departments to accelerate deemed conveyance for housing societies. This initiative aims to secure legal ownership for nearly sixty-seven thousand societies. Revenue and land records departments will coordinate to update property ownership details. This process is crucial for societies planning redevelopment and self-redevelopment projects. The government is establishing a mechanism to speed up applications and encourage new ones.

news.title: Bengaluru: Apartment bill’s sweeping powers for officials raises concerns
news.para: A newly enacted bill bestows significant authority upon a designated body to tackle the challenges faced by apartment owners. This authority possesses the capability to scrutinize project finances and operations without needing formal complaints to initiate investigations. While many residents embrace this intervention, fears of possible abuse of these extensive powers linger.
